abbott_smith_html:
γυνή, -αικός, ἡ,
[in LXX for אִשָּׁה ;]
__1. a woman, married or unmarried: Mat.11:11 14:21, al.; ὕπανδρος γ., Rom.7:2; γ. χήρα, Luk.4:26; in vocat., γύναι implies neither reproof nor severity, but is used frequently as a term of respect and endearment, Mat.15:28, Jhn.2:4, 4:21 19:26.
__2. a wife: Mat.1:20, 1Co.7:3, 4 al.; γ. ἀπολύειν, Mrk.10:2, al.; γ. ἔχειν Mrk.6:18; γ. λαβεῖν, Mrk.12:19; γ. γαμεῖν, Luk.14:20.
__3. a deaconess, 1Ti.3:11 (CGT, in l.).
(AS)

strongs_1890.derivation: probably from the base of G1096 (γίνομαι);

occurrences.bsb: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
occurrences.kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

occurrences.bsb: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.
occurrences.kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

occurrences.bsb: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
occurrences.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

occurrences.bsb: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews, however, incited the religious women of prominence and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
occurrences.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

occurrences.bsb: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where he found a disciple named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman and a Greek father.
occurrences.kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

occurrences.bsb: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate along the river, where it was customary to find a place of prayer. After sitting down, we spoke to the women who had gathered there.
occurrences.kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

occurrences.bsb: Among those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

occurrences.bsb: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few leading women.
occurrences.kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

occurrences.bsb: As a result, many of them believed, along with quite a few prominent Greek women and men.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

occurrences.bsb: But some joined him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others who were with them.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

occurrences.bsb: There he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to visit them,
occurrences.kjv: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

occurrences.bsb: But when our time there had ended, we set out on our journey. All the disciples, with their wives and children, accompanied us out of the city and knelt down on the beach to pray with us.
occurrences.kjv: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

occurrences.bsb: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
occurrences.kjv: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

occurrences.bsb: After several days, Felix returned with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
occurrences.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

occurrences.bsb: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
occurrences.kjv: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father’s wife.

occurrences.bsb: Now for the matters you wrote about: It is good to abstain from sexual relations.
occurrences.kjv: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.

occurrences.bsb: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.

occurrences.bsb: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
occurrences.kjv: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.

occurrences.bsb: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.
occurrences.kjv: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.

occurrences.bsb: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:

occurrences.bsb: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
occurrences.kjv: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.

occurrences.bsb: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
occurrences.kjv: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

occurrences.bsb: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.

occurrences.bsb: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
occurrences.kjv: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.

occurrences.bsb: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
occurrences.kjv: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?

occurrences.bsb: Are you committed to a wife? Do not seek to be released. Are you free of commitment? Do not look for a wife.
occurrences.kjv: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.

occurrences.bsb: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
occurrences.kjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

occurrences.bsb: But the married man is concerned about the affairs of this world, how he can please his wife,
occurrences.kjv: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.

occurrences.bsb: and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
occurrences.kjv: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

occurrences.bsb: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
occurrences.kjv: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

occurrences.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

occurrences.bsb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
occurrences.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

occurrences.bsb: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
occurrences.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

occurrences.bsb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
occurrences.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

occurrences.bsb: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
occurrences.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

occurrences.bsb: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
occurrences.kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

occurrences.bsb: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
occurrences.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

occurrences.bsb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
occurrences.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

occurrences.bsb: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
occurrences.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.

occurrences.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
occurrences.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

occurrences.bsb: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
occurrences.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

occurrences.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
occurrences.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

occurrences.bsb: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

occurrences.bsb: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
occurrences.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
occurrences.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

occurrences.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
occurrences.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

occurrences.bsb: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
occurrences.kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

occurrences.bsb: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
occurrences.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

occurrences.bsb: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
occurrences.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

occurrences.bsb: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
occurrences.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

occurrences.bsb: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
occurrences.kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

occurrences.bsb: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
occurrences.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
occurrences.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

occurrences.bsb: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
occurrences.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

occurrences.bsb: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to her husband,
occurrences.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

occurrences.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
occurrences.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

occurrences.bsb: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
occurrences.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

occurrences.bsb: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

occurrences.bsb: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
occurrences.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

occurrences.bsb: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
occurrences.kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

occurrences.bsb: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
occurrences.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

occurrences.bsb: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
occurrences.kjv: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

occurrences.bsb: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, hurling them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
occurrences.kjv: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

occurrences.bsb: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

occurrences.bsb: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
occurrences.kjv: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.

occurrences.bsb: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
occurrences.kjv: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

occurrences.bsb: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
occurrences.kjv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

occurrences.bsb: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
occurrences.kjv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

occurrences.bsb: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
occurrences.kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
occurrences.kjv: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

occurrences.bsb: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:

occurrences.bsb: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

occurrences.bsb: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
occurrences.kjv: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.

occurrences.bsb: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
occurrences.kjv: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.

occurrences.bsb: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
occurrences.kjv: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
occurrences.kjv: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.
